title: Port package system modules (core, apt, git, subproc)
description: Port the package system modules to Common Lisp: core (read-card, generate-repo-index, slurp-degasolv-repo), apt (Debian Packages.gz parsing), git (stub), and subproc (process execution).

title: Port resolver core (data structures + algorithm)
description: Port the core resolver data structures and algorithm from degasolv Clojure to Common Lisp. This includes the package-info, requirement, version-predicate, and decorated-requirement structs, plus the string-to-requirement parser, version comparison logic, spec-calling, and the full resolve-dependencies-deluxe algorithm with all strategies (thorough/fast, exclusive/inclusive/prioritized, breadth-first/depth-first).

title: Port CLI interface using CLIFF
description: Port the CLI interface using CLIFF. This includes the execute-program entry point, resolve-locations, query-repo, generate-card, generate-repo-index, display-config subcommands, option parsing, config file loading, environment variable handling, and option pack expansion.

title: Port utility functions (data-slurp, repo aggregation)
description: Port the utility functions to Common Lisp: base-slurp, data-slurp (HTTP with auth support), default-spit, pretty-spit, map-query, priority-repo, global-repo, and aggregator.

title: Create Roswell script and ASDF system definition
description: Create the Roswell script (com.djhaskin.dsolv.ros) that wraps the main function and creates the dsolv executable. Also create the ASDF system definition and qlfile with proper dependencies.

Add checks:

- No trailing whitespace
- File header comments (;;;;)
- Other style guide checks

Test it on the project source files.
notes:
✅ Forked fmt.ros into .agents/skills/djha-skin-common-lisp/scripts/fmt.ros
✅ Added checks: 80-char lines, trailing whitespace, file headers (;;;;)
✅ Tested: works on all project source files

✅ Script tested on itself - catches its own violations too

The fmt.ros script:
- Usage: ros dsolv-fmt.ros [--check|--fix] <files...>
- --check: only lint, don't format
- --fix: fix trailing whitespace
- Without flags: format via cl-indentify + lint
- Discovers .lisp/.ros files in src/ and tests/ by default
